statement.p: Find the zeros, if any, of the function y = 4\mathopen{}\left(x+8\right)^{2}-8.
Enter your answer as a comma separated list. If no zeros exist, enter NONE.

solution.p: We can solve the equation 4\mathopen{}\left(x+8\right)^{2}-8 = 0 algebraically. \begin{array}{rcl} 4\mathopen{}\left(x+8\right)^{2}-8 \amp = \amp 0 \\ 4(x+8)^2 \amp = \amp + 8 \\ (x+8)^2 \amp = \amp + 2 \\ x+8 \amp = \amp \pm \sqrt{ + 2} \\ x \amp = \amp -8 \pm \sqrt{ + 2}. \end{array}
